services.title: Organizational change facilitation
services.body: Guiding executive teams and entire workforces through complex transitions with clarity and alignment.

services.title: Leadership development
services.body: Equipping leaders with the emotional intelligence and strategic frameworks they need in high-pressure environments.

services.title: AI upskilling and talent strategy
services.body: Redesigning how you attract, develop, and enable people, including how your managers lead alongside AI, when the old playbooks no longer apply.

process.title: Start with a conversation
process.body: You describe what’s happening, what’s been tried, and what success would actually look like.

process.title: Diagnose before prescribing
process.body: Interviews, observation, and your existing data, to understand the real problem rather than the presenting one.

process.title: Design the engagement
process.body: Scope, format, and timeline, tailored rather than templated. Some engagements are six-week sprints; others are 18-month partnerships.

process.title: Work alongside your team
process.body: I’m in the room: leading offsites, coaching leaders weekly, facilitating difficult conversations.

cases.title: Rebuilding leadership alignment after an unexpected CEO departure
cases.situation: A senior team drawn from three autonomous divisions had never operated as a unit. With a $2B endowment, a new board chair, and a strategic plan due in six months, the organization needed a steady hand and a clear path.
cases.engagement: A six-month executive alignment series, plus individual coaching for four direct reports stepping into new visibility.
outcomes: Strategic framework endorsed unanimously by the board
Two senior leaders who had signaled departures chose to stay
Interim CEO appointed permanently with broad internal confidence

cases.title: People integration after a culture-defining acquisition
cases.situation: An acquisition joined a legacy broadcast network and a digital-first streaming operation. The cultures clashed openly, and high-performer attrition was rising on both sides within the first year.
cases.engagement: An 18-month leadership program for managers across both organizations in 14 markets, anchored in a shared people philosophy built with HR leadership.
outcomes: Voluntary attrition among high performers declined meaningfully
Shared manager competency model adopted across 14 markets
HR leadership cited the program as foundational to integration

cases.title: Talent architecture for a fund that outgrew its infrastructure
cases.situation: Rapid AUM growth outpaced management infrastructure. Investment professionals inherited people-management duties with no structured support, and junior retention risk was rising.
cases.engagement: A full talent architecture (career tracks, performance frameworks, a competency model) and a manager readiness program for 24 portfolio managers and senior analysts.
outcomes: Structured career paths across four asset classes
Managers reported materially higher confidence within 90 days
Program expanded to operations and technology within the year

testimonials.quote: Willie has a rare ability to hold a room. We brought him in for a leadership offsite with a team that had never been asked to work together as a unit. He read the dynamics immediately and facilitated us to alignment that shaved years off our timeline.

Our workforce spans five generations and a dozen countries. Willie navigated that complexity with a fluency I haven't seen from any other facilitator. He found the common ground without flattening the differences.
He opened our leadership summit and set the tone for the entire year. Honest, energizing, and immediately actionable. Our team is still referencing that talk six months later.
